item.description: RVNL’s Q2 FY27 profit rose 8.3% year over year, while revenue fell 8.2%. Texmaco Rail’s consolidated profit jumped 73.7%, despite lower revenue and a decline in standalone profit.

item.title: New Sebi proposal could flip fates of key men at NSE, BSE
item.description: Proposed amendments to tenures of MDs of exchanges revise age-based limit to term-based limit. Ashishkumar Chauhan may be barred from another term at NSE because of his prior service at BSE, while Sundararaman Ramamurthy could continue at BSE beyond age 65 and potentially serve at another exchange.

item.title: PBOC Anchors Yuan With Stable Fix as Volatility Jumps After APEC
item.description: China’s central bank signaled it wants to curb sharp moves in the yuan with a largely steady fixing Friday, after the currency posted its biggest drop since March following a trilateral leaders’ meeting.

item.title: Anthropic and SpaceX IPOs bring Bitcoin prices down? Is investor money shifting from crypto to AI stocks? What’s next?
item.description: Bitcoin and Ether fell sharply before the Anthropic and SpaceX IPOs, raising questions about capital shifting from crypto to stocks. Analysts say the declines also reflect ETF outflows, liquidations and broader risk aversion.&nbsp;

item.title: WeWork India share price jumps 40% in 6 months; ICICI Direct sees 37% more gains ahead - Buy? Check Target
item.description: WeWork India shares fell 1.60% to ₹683.30 on Friday, extending weekly losses, but have gained about 40% in six months. ICICI Securities expects the company to fund planned capex internally and forecasts 22% revenue and EBITDA growth, maintaining a Buy rating with a ₹933 target.

item.title: Stock split reset: SanDisk stock crashes 87.5% overnight? Here's what investors need to know about its 8-for-1 split
item.description: SanDisk completed an eight-for-one stock split, giving eligible shareholders seven additional shares for each share held. The adjustment lowered the per-share price from $755.16 to about $94.40 without changing investors’ ownership or the company’s market value

item.title: PSU vs Private banks: Who is powering Nifty Bank's record-high rally after 5% surge? SBI, HDFC, AU, Canara target price
item.description: Banking stocks led the November market rally, with Nifty Bank rising around 16% month-to-date to a record intraday high of 64,485 on November 20. PSU and private bank indexes also advanced sharply, while brokerages cited healthy credit demand and robust lending pipelines.

item.title: Gold, silver price crash: DSP Mutual Fund turns bullish on bullion, reveals new buying strategy; check price levels
item.description: Gold prices plunged to a 14-month low, recording their steepest weekly decline in eight months amid interest-rate concerns and an AI-stock selloff. DSP Mutual Fund is gradually buying gold and silver as prices fall, using predefined price levels rather than trying to predict a market bottom.

item.title: Mahanadi CoalFields IPO GMP Check: Down 92% from ₹9.25 to ₹0.7, issue struggles to attract bids- Subscribe or avoid?
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields’ ₹8,981 crore IPO remained undersubscribed after two days, while its grey-market premium plunged 92% to ₹0.70, implying just 0.51% potential listing gains. Brokerages remain positive on its production scale, cash flows and dividends, but near-term investor demand is weak.

item.title: Taiwan Widens Short Sale Curbs After Shares Plunge on AI Concern
item.description: Taiwan widened curbs on short sales of local stocks and said it has been buying shares, stepping up efforts to revive confidence after the island’s benchmark index had its worst weekly fall in 35 years.

item.title: Patanjali Foods dividend 2026 announcement news: Board to consider 2nd interim dividend on Nov 26 - Check history, yield
item.description: Patanjali Foods will meet on November 26, 2026, to consider and approve a second interim dividend for FY27. The amount and record date have not been announced. Its trading window has been closed since November 21 and will reopen 48 hours after the dividend declaration.
